channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Community briefs: Local groups plan events
item.description: Upcoming Wilson-area events include a free Sunday food plate giveaway, federal retirees’ meeting, A&T scholarship banquet, free tax prep site and a call for DAV volunteer drivers.

item.title: Council clashes over appointment process
item.description: Wilson City Council approved a formal board-appointment process after heated debate Thursday morning.

item.title: Wilson’s Alliance One, Nashville’s Universal Leaf named Exporters of the Year
item.description: Alliance One in Wilson and Universal Leaf in Nashville have been named North Carolina's 2026 Exporters of the Year for their role in expanding global markets for the state's tobacco industry.

item.title: 3rd man facing attempted murder and kidnapping charges
item.description: A third suspect has been charged with attempted murder, kidnapping in targeted assault on Wilson man.

item.title: Today’s Republicans are a party without legitimate political ancestors
item.description: An opinion piece argues modern Republicans are betraying Madison and Hamilton’s vision of broad voter access, pushing restrictive election laws that break with the party’s own democratic roots.

item.title: When the heat turns on, electric bills shouldn’t break families
item.description: As Duke Energy seeks a 15% rate hike, North Carolina advocates and state leaders warn higher bills could force low-income families into painful trade-offs and push for cheaper renewable alternatives.

item.title: Open enrollment: a win for parents and public schools
item.description: As North Carolina wrestles with declining public school enrollment and frustrated parents, expanding open enrollment within districts could keep families in the system and spur improvement.

item.title: You Decide: What’s the best tax?
item.description: Economist Mike Walden explains how federal, state and local governments tax income, sales, property and wealth, and outlines the trade-offs in the ongoing debate over what kind of tax is best.

item.title: Aviation nonprofit invites public for tours
item.description: Wilson-based Adventist World Aviation is inviting residents to tour its global headquarters, learn how it supports humanitarian flights worldwide and see aircraft operations.

item.title: Tickets on sale for 2nd Southern Nash HOF ceremony March 28
item.description: Tickets are on sale for Southern Nash High’s second Athletic Hall of Fame induction March 28 at 6 p.m., honoring eight former student-athletes across four decades; $50 with dinner at gofan.co.
